headline: **MLB Daily Recap: July 26, 2026**
article:
The Tampa Bay Rays edged out the Cleveland Guardians 1-0, with Drew Rasmussen earning the win after 7.0 innings of scoreless relief. In other action, the Washington Nationals secured a 10-7 victory over the Arizona Diamondbacks, with CJ Abrams leading the charge at the plate, going 3 for 5 with 2 home runs and 3 RBIs. The Pittsburgh Pirates also pulled off a thrilling comeback, defeating the Chicago Cubs 8-7.

Several key players have been impacted by injuries. Cody Bellinger, the left fielder for the New York Yankees, has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a left hamstring strain. Additionally, Shea Langeliers of the Athletics has been placed on the 10-day injured list retroactive to July 25, 2026, with a torn meniscus in his right knee.

Several teams have made roster moves ahead of the trade deadline. The St. Louis Cardinals traded RHP Scott Blewett to the Athletics for cash. The Pittsburgh Pirates traded RHP José Urquidy to the Chicago White Sox for RHP Felix Doroteo. The Boston Red Sox traded LHP Connelly Early to the Washington Nationals for 3B Curtis Mead. The Kansas City Royals traded CF Kameron Misner to the Philadelphia Phillies for cash.
